ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to localized distal tip regions and sparse superficial mottling, yielding a very low overall contrast ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark contiguous pixel block across both lobes. High-contrast white pixel mapping is concentrated at the distal tips and in small (<10px) isolated clusters scattered asymmetrically across the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile. Trailing edge displays high-amplitude peaks and valleys, including a significant semi-circular indentation on the medial margin of the right lobe and multiple jagged sawtooth notches on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the distal margins of both lobes, terminating in sharp, tapered tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white pixels localized at the distal tips and along the jagged peaks of the trailing edge, consistent with localized surface scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (white streaks) are visible on the medial portion of the right lobe, oriented diagonally relative to the horizontal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant tissue loss and irregular notches along the entire trailing edge margin; extensive white depigmentation/scarring at the distal extremities.
